notes.title: Update Ver.1.1.0 – New Features, Options, and More
notes.content:
"A Fugu's Dive" has been updated to Ver.1.1.0, bringing a brand-new mode, new options, and various improvements and fixes.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45458671/c4fac3c935f88116c4b0dbd4603d791e53848d80.png[/img][img][/img]

[list]
[*]Added Reverse Challenge mode, where you head from the goal back to the start!
(Unlocked after clearing the game once)
[*]Added special fugu colors.
(Unlocked by meeting certain conditions)
[*]Added “Fugu Records” to the pause menu.
(Your best time has been moved here)
[*]Added “How to Play” to the pause menu.
[*]Added a new option: Pull Sensitivity – adjust how responsive pulling feels.
[*]Added a new option: Always Show Timer – keep the timer visible at all times.
[*]Added a new option: Hide Falling Fugus – turn off background fugu clutter.
[*]Added screen transition effects for smoother scene changes.
[*]Added new background textures in some areas.
[*]Adjusted overall sound balance.
[*]Fixed a bug where some effects were not visible in certain spots.
[/list]

To celebrate Japan’s Golden Week, the game is 20% off from April 29 to May 9.
Feel free to check it out during the sale!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3435050/_/
